name: WF-453 — Acquisition Scaling Approval → Budget Allocation & Lead Generation Execution Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const period=String(b.period??'').trim(); const approvalId=String(b.approvalId??b.requestId??'').trim(); const requestedBudget=Number(b.requestedBudget??b.budget??0); const requestedLeadVolume=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(Number(b.requestedLeadVolume??b.leadVolume??0))); return [{json:{...b,portfolioId,period,approvalId,requestedBudget,requestedLeadVolume,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Acquisition Scaling Approval').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const flags=[]; const approval=String(ctx.approvalStatus??ctx.status??'').toLowerCase(); const approved=ctx.approved===true||['approved','authorized'].includes(approval); const requesterAuthorized=ctx.requesterAuthorized!==false; const budgetLimit=n(ctx.maxApprovedBudget??ctx.budgetLimit); const currentBudget=n(ctx.currentBudget); const requestedBudget=n(input.requestedBudget); const availableBudget=n(ctx.availableBudget??ctx.remainingBudget); const leadCapacity=n(ctx.availableLeadCapacity??ctx.availableCapacity); const requestedLeads=input.requestedLeadVolume; if(!approved)flags.push('scaling_not_approved'); if(!requesterAuthorized)flags.push('requester_not_authorized'); if(requestedBudget<0)flags.push('negative_budget'); if(budgetLimit>0&&requestedBudget>budgetLimit)flags.push('budget_exceeds_approved_limit'); if(availableBudget>0&&requestedBudget>availableBudget)flags.push('insufficient_available_budget'); if(leadCapacity>0&&requestedLeads>leadCapacity)flags.push('lead_capacity_exceeded'); const budgetDelta=Math.round((requestedBudget-currentBudget)*100)/100; const executionAllowed=flags.length===0&&approved&&requesterAuthorized; let decision='hold_execution',nextAction='resolve_scaling_approval_or_capacity_exception',executionState='blocked'; if(executionAllowed){decision='execute_acquisition_scaling';nextAction='allocate_approved_budget_and_activate_lead_generation';executionState='approved_for_execution';} else if(!approved&&!flags.includes('requester_not_authorized')){decision='await_approval';nextAction='obtain_explicit_budget_scaling_approval';executionState='pending_approval';} const idempotencyKey='wf453:'+input.portfolioId+':'+input.period+':'+input.approvalId; return [{json:{...input,acquisitionScalingExecution:{executionState,decision,nextAction,approved,requesterAuthorized,currentBudget,requestedBudget,budgetDelta,requestedLeadVolume:requestedLeads,availableBudget,availableLeadCapacity:leadCapacity,flags,executionAllowed,requiresHumanReview:!executionAllowed,confidenceScore:executionAllowed?95:25},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Validates explicit approval, requester authorization, budget limits and lead-handling capacity before creating an acquisition budget/lead-generation execution request. This workflow records and dispatches an execution request; actual ad-platform spend changes remain behind verified production integrations and approval controls.
